brief_summary: FIXTURE:Investigation evidence indicates mechanical failure in the downlock assembly with mixed hydraulic system observations.

hypotheses.statement: FIXTURE:Stress corrosion cracking in the actuator cylinder caused uncommanded extension resistance.

supporting_evidence.quote: FIXTURE:Metallurgical laboratory analysis confirmed micro-void coalescence and stress corrosion cracking in the actuator cylinder.

contradicting_evidence.quote: FIXTURE:Mandatory replacement of actuator return spring assembly within 50 flight cycles as corrective action.

hypotheses.reasoning: FIXTURE:Laboratory analysis supports metallurgical fatigue, but the required return spring replacement suggests mechanical binding contributed independently.
limitations: FIXTURE:Metallurgical evidence does not establish definitive operational sequence.

hypotheses.statement: FIXTURE:Pre-existing fatigue fracture of the downlock pin prevented mechanical locking during extension.

supporting_evidence.quote: FIXTURE:Post-flight inspection revealed that the main landing gear downlock pin had fractured along the shear plane.

hypotheses.reasoning: FIXTURE:Physical pin fracture observed on post-flight inspection indicates locking failure.
limitations: FIXTURE:Pin fracture may have occurred on ground impact rather than in-flight.

documented_findings.statement: FIXTURE:Post-flight inspection documented that the main downlock pin was fractured along its shear plane.
documented_findings.quote: FIXTURE:Post-flight inspection revealed that the main landing gear downlock pin had fractured along the shear plane.

missing_information: FIXTURE:Flight data recorder hydraulic pressure sensor traces during final approach.
FIXTURE:Maintenance log records for actuator overhaul interval.

suggested_investigative_checks.check: FIXTURE:Perform ultrasonic non-destructive testing on fleet actuator cylinder housings.
suggested_investigative_checks.rationale: FIXTURE:Identify latent stress corrosion cracking before operational failure.
suggested_investigative_checks.safety_note: FIXTURE:For qualified maintenance personnel only; not an airworthiness directive.

overall_limitations: FIXTURE:Investigation support output only; not an official airworthiness determination.
